bahir-dar-university.summary: Bahir Dar University was established on 6 May 2000 by merging Bahir Dar Polytechnic and Bahir Dar Teachers’ College. It is one of Ethiopia’s largest universities, with colleges, faculties, institutes, schools and academies across engineering, health, agriculture, education, business and the social sciences.
